## CLIENT DOSSIER
# Silver Nova · Venice → Athens & Greek Isles — Shore Excursion Plan
## Built for 72-year-old travelers · Food / wine / short-walking focus · Under $150 pp
*Source: Silversea Tour Programmes DM_1548442 (May 5–15), DM_1548443 (May 15–22), DM_1548444 (May 22–29), 2027. Prices "indicative," per person, subject to change. Mobility flags quoted from each tour's official "Please note."*

---

## THE GEMS — book these first (explicitly senior/limited-mobility friendly)

| Port | Code | Tour | $pp | Why it's a gem |
|------|------|------|-----|----------------|
| Crete | **SDH-I** | Treasures of Cretan Culture | **$89** | ✅ *Suitable for limited mobility.* Winery (wine + olive oil tasting) + take-home soap workshop. Only easy food tour on Crete. |
| Kusadasi | **KUS-G** | Easy Ephesus | **$79** | ✅ *Suitable for limited mobility.* World-class Ephesus (Celsus Library, Great Theatre) at the lowest price anywhere on the voyage. |
| Nafplion | **NAV-F** | Wine Tasting in Nemea | **$119** | ✅ *Suitable for limited mobility.* Skouras winery, 1,000-barrel cellar, 5 wines + snacks. Minimal walking. The dream day. |
| Split | **SPL-B** | Picturesque Town of Trogir | **$79** | ✅ *Suitable for limited mobility.* UNESCO Trogir + cathedral, ends with drink & Trogirski rafioli cookies. |
| Rhodes | **RHO-E** | Panoramic Rhodes (Philerimos) | **$79** | ✅ *Suitable for limited mobility* (not wheelchair). Philerimos monastery + pottery demo, minimal walking. |
| Mykonos | **JMK-B** | Mykonos Panorama | **$69** | ✅ *Wheelchair accessible* w/ assist. Beaches + monastery + taverna with Greek appetizers & ouzo. |
| Athens | **PIR-S** | Athens at Your Leisure | **$69** | ✅ *Suitable for limited mobility.* Self-paced city tour, walking at your discretion, 5 hrs free. |
| Paros | **NSA-D** | Chrissi Akti Beach | **$89** | Minimal effort (200 m). 3 hrs at golden-sand beach — a genuine rest day. |

---
